versions.changelog:
Initial release of the private-equity skill suite.

- Provides a modular set of tools covering term sheet review, due diligence checklists, investment committee memos, return modeling, deal screening, and exit analysis.
- Enforces strict workflow: intent recognition, subskill routing, full-template execution, structured output, and quality gate.
- Features built-in checklists for core term sheet/SPA clauses and exit path quantification (IRR/probability matrix).
- Aligns workflow to a six-step closed-loop process with clear acceptance criteria and division of digital roles.
- Supports cross-skill collaboration (industry research, legal, tax), with standardized coordination guidance.
- Includes robust cycle and quality control parameters for iterative tasks and error handling.
